newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Cocoa seen turning up but resistance soon.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Cocoa seen turning up but resistance soon.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
LIFFE cocoa futures were seen turning mildly bullish in the near-term, but stiff resistance was ahead and could put cocoa back into a range.
July was called to open unchanged after erasing early losses on Wednesday to close up five stg at 1,028 stg per tonne, near the session and weekly high.
CSCE July cocoa also ended strongly on Wednesday, with July up $17 at $1,486 after hitting a one-month high during the session.
"Cocoa is bucking up a bit and becoming mildly bullish," said Elli Gifford, independent technical analyst.
But July resistance loomed nearby at 1,033 stg. She said that could limit July's near-term gains and keep cocoa in a range.
"Support has been established just over 1,000, somewhere near 1,010," she said. "I suspect we'll see some ranging going on."
